notes: The elven funerary site turns first -- its dead walk in daylight from day 2 and its ghosts from day 3 -- and it is the only habitat that ever holds an Eldritch creature, from day 12.
world.cell.tomb_service_passage is territory because D3's ungated wrong turn inside the tomb is answered by this precinct's guardians; B7's battle entry there binds to this habitat by ID.
Field names and value spellings are HabitatRecord's in godot-rust/src/habitat.rs verbatim, because habitat::tests::fixture_matches_the_authored_habitats holds the two equal field for field.
